## This event is currently Full. Please add your team to the waitlist and we will contact you if any space opens up. 


**A minimum of 16 registered teams is required for this event to be held.**
**Maximum capacity is 32 teams.**

The event is open to male athletes aged seventy (70) or over and female athletes aged sixty-five (65) or over on February 28th in the same year of the Championship. Each team will be composed of four or five women or four or five men or any combination of women and men playing on any team position. Four Event Format with three game guarantee.

- All team members must also register once per season as a participant of Curling Ontario at https://on.curling.io/en/products/10513-curling-ontario-participant-registration-2026-2027
- Additional eligibility requirements may apply - see Competitor Guide posted at https://curlingontario.ca/competitions/competition-regulations/ for details. 

Communications will be sent to all participants for which a valid email address is provided. Please have this information ready when completing your team registration.

**Withdrawals and Refunds**

- Should a team enter a Curling Ontario qualifier and choose to withdraw from an event prior to the entry deadline they will receive a refund, less 10% to cover processing fees.
- To mitigate the disruption caused by last-minute alterations, Teams who choose to change qualifiers forfeit their original entry fee and must pay another full entry fee to register for the new qualifier of their choice.
- Teams cannot change qualifiers after the entry deadline. There are no refunds for teams who withdraw after the entry deadline. 
- To change your qualifier you must register for the new one you’d like to participate in BY THE REGISTRATION DEADLINE and email competitions@curlingontario.ca to request to be removed from the one you no longer wish to participate in.
- If a team withdraws after the draw schedule has been released that team’s games will be replaced with byes.
